correctness.rationale: The doubling action shifts binary digits, so the two half-open holes correspond to 000 and 111. Away from null dyadic ambiguities, n tests use n+2 digits, each word having Lebesgue probability 2^(−n−2). Independent exhaustive inclusion–exclusion over subsets of hole-test positions for each schedule through n=5 accounts for compatible fixed digits and zeroes inconsistent intersections. The minima are 7,12,21,37,64; alternation attains the first four and has 65 at n=5. Exactly 01001,01101,10010,10110 attain 64. Independently counting admissible whole-period words by their initial and final suffix states, then applying the Newton trace identities, gives the two stated period matrices and characteristic polynomials t(t³−2t²−3t−1) and t(t³−6t²+4t−1). The second matrix is positive and the square of the first is positive. By Perron–Frobenius theory multiplication by the fixed partial-period prefix for each residue class gives a positive leading scalar (each suffix always has a valid continuation), proving the full limits. The unique-real-root discriminants are −23 and −139. Exact rational brackets were checked as stated; 3079595³−10⁶·5278040²=1348881297924569875>0. Thus the period-three growth is strictly smaller, producing faster escape, with no global all-schedule optimality claim. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/check_4.py and check_4.out beside it.
